scientific_integrity: Uses the published characteristic-two Pellet/Berlekamp identity explicitly; a self-contained coefficient bijection and character-sum calculation prove the stated sign-resolved table. Finite root-enumeration verifies examples without replacing the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only monic cubics, q a power of two, nonconstant affine shifts. A pre-existing squarefree-overlap count is not claimed as new. Independent historical priority may be incomplete.
title: Exact joint Möbius-sign distribution for affine shifts of binary-field cubics
